title: Archive Helper — get incoming links count (parameters)
description: Paste into Contentful App Action 'parametersSchema' (JSON Schema draft-04). Space and environment are supplied by the host; body typically only needs entryId.

entryId.description: Target entry id — count entries with inbound links to this entry.

previewSize.description: Optional number of sample linking entries to include in the result (0 = count only).
